dialogue.warfront.order_offer_eliminate: Contract: eliminate %s soldiers of %s. Accept through dialogue.
dialogue.warfront.order_offer_recon: Contract: scout a base of %2$s and return. Accept through dialogue.
dialogue.warfront.recon_complete: Recon objective sighted. Return to your contact.
dialogue.warfront.intel_nearest_base: Our nearest position is at x=%s, z=%s — head %s.
dialogue.warfront.intel_rival_base: %s holds a position at x=%s, z=%s.
dialogue.warfront.intel_no_base: No positions worth mentioning around here.
dialogue.warfront.intel_patrol_hint: Patrols pass through here — keep your eyes on the ridgelines.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_sor: I'm sorry for what I did.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_was: I came to say I was wrong.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_kno: What I did to your people was wrong, and I know it.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_no_: No excuses. I did wrong by you.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_reg: I regret what happened between us.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_own: I've come to own my mistakes.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_des: You deserved better from me. I'm sorry.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_str: Let me say it straight: I was in the wrong.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_adm: I wronged your side, and I'm here to admit it.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_thi: I keep thinking about what I did. I'm sorry for it.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_no_: There's no defending what I did. So I won't.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_fac: I wanted to apologize face to face.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_rec: I was reckless, and your people paid for it. I'm sorry.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_lat: Consider this an apology, late but honest.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_sha: My behavior was shameful. I'm here to say so.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_verbal_par: I ask your pardon for what I've done.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_deep_whole: I'll say it in front of the whole camp if that helps: I was wrong.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_deep_carri: I've carried this a long way to say: forgive me.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_deep_not_l: I'm not leaving until you hear my apology properly.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_deep_faile: Whatever it costs me to say it: I failed you, and I'm sorry.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_deep_in_th: Look me in the eye. I wronged you, and I'm ashamed of it.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_deep_rehea: I've rehearsed this apology for days. Every word is meant.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_deep_punis: Punish me if you want, but hear me first: I am truly sorry.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_deep_honor: On my honor, such as it is: I repent what I did to your people.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_light_busi: Sorry about all that business before.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_light_no_h: Hey, no hard feelings about everything, right?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_light_past: Can we just put the past behind us?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_light_said: I said sorry already. Doesn't that count?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_ask_make_r: What would it take to make things right?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_ask_fix_th: How do I fix this between us?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_ask_price_: Tell me the price of forgiveness.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_ask_goods_: What do you want from me — goods, work, blood?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_ask_earn_b: How does someone earn their way back with your side?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_ask_name_a: Name the amends. I'll pay them.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_ask_some_w: There must be some way to square this.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_ask_office: What would your officers accept as repayment?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_ask_clean_: If I wanted a clean slate, where would I start?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_ask_debt_s: Walk me through how a debt like mine gets settled.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_ask_path_b: Is there a path back for someone like me?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_ask_tribut: What tribute would soften your people?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_ask_hole_d: How deep is the hole I've dug, and what fills it?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_tribute_ir: Eight iron ingots, for the harm I caused. Take them.
I brought iron as amends. A full stack of eight.
Let this iron speak where my words failed — eight bars.
Iron for your smiths, offered in apology.
Take these eight ingots as a first payment on my debt.
My apology comes with iron this time. Eight pieces.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_tribute_em: Three emeralds, offered to mend what I broke.
I brought emeralds as an apology. Three of them.
Take these three gems toward my debt.
Emeralds for the wronged. Three, and my regret with them.
A tribute of three emeralds, if your people will have it.
Let three green stones start paying for my mistakes.
Six emeralds. A real tribute for real harm.
I've saved six emeralds to put toward what I owe you.
This purse holds six gems. Take it as serious amends.
Six emeralds — the weight of my apology in stone.
For the damage done, six emeralds. Count them.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_tribute_di: A diamond. The hardest thing I own, for the hardest debt I owe.
I brought a diamond. Let it answer for everything I can't undo.
One diamond, for the worst of what I did.
Take this diamond as blood-price. I know words won't do.
A diamond for your dead. It's not enough. Nothing is. But take it.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_plea_hear_: I know you'd rather kill me than hear me. Hear me anyway.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_plea_betra: I betrayed you. I'm not here to deny it — I'm here to face it.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_plea_name_: Is there anything left of my name here worth saving?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_plea_unarm: I'll wait here unarmed until someone accepts my apology.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_plea_curse: Curse me if you need to. Then tell me how to begin repaying you.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_plea_unfor: What I did was unforgivable. I'm asking anyway.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_plea_every: You have every right to hate me. I came regardless.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_plea_blame: If your side needs someone to blame, blame me to my face.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_plea_earn_: I don't ask for trust. I ask for a chance to earn the asking.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_plea_kneel: Even the guilty get to kneel. So here I am.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_promise_wo: It won't happen again. You have my word.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_promise_ch: I've changed. Give me the chance to prove it.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_promise_no: From today, your people have nothing to fear from me.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_promise_sw: I swear off everything I did to earn your anger.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_promise_wa: Watch me. My conduct will speak from here on.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_promise_be: I promise to be better to your side than I was.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_promise_wh: The person who wronged you is done. I'm what's left.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_promise_op: Whatever I was to you before, I intend to be the opposite.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_blood_answ: I killed your people. I want to answer for it.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_blood_hand: There's blood on my hands. Your blood. I'm here about that.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_blood_took: I took lives from your side. I won't pretend otherwise.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_blood_my_d: Your dead are my doing. Tell me what I owe.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_blood_conf: I've come to confess: I cut down your soldiers.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_blood_didn: Some of your people didn't come home because of me. I know it.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_blood_colo: I killed soldiers who wore your colors. I carry every one.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_blood_grav: The graves on your side — some are mine to answer for.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_blood_wont: I won't hide it. I've spilled your blood, and I regret it.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_blood_name: Name your dead, and I'll tell you which ones I owe you for.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_blood_some: I fought your people and some fell. I'm here to face their friends.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_blood_just: Whatever justice your side wants for its dead, I'm listening.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_nice_bad_b: I hope there's no bad blood between us.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_nice_toes: If I've ever stepped on your toes, I apologize.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_nice_still: Just making sure we're still square.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_nice_are_w: No grudge sitting between us, I hope?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_nice_good_: I try to stay in your people's good graces. How am I doing?
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_nice_offen: If I ever gave offense, it was never meant.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_nice_name_: I value my name with your side. Tell me it still holds.
dialogue.warfront.opt.apology_nice_griev: No grievances between us that I should know about?
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_verbal.vo: Words. Lighter than snow, and snow buries men. But we heard it. The ledger softens a hair.
Sorry doesn't fill graves. It fills silence. Fine — the silence needed filling.
An apology, spine straight, sober. That's more than most manage. One small mark in your favor.
Apology heard. The line moves on. Mostly it just moves.
Fine. Words logged in the general direction of forgiveness.
Bah, you apologize like it's a funeral. We're past it, friend. Mostly past it.
Heard and shelved. Friends fight, friends dig, friends drink. Order varies.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_verbal.ae: Statement received and appended to your file. Sentiment noted. Balance barely moved.
A verbal apology adjusts perception, not the record. Both matter. One just moved slightly.
Acknowledged. Contrition is a data point. Continue generating better ones.
Apology logged. No open grievances at this time.
Received. The file reflects a cooperative posture. Maintain it.
Unnecessary but appreciated, friend. The ledger between us reads clean.
Apology accepted and honestly overkill. We're square.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_verbal.sa: Words are wind. But some winds cool the tea. We felt this one. Slightly.
An apology walks in front of amends like a herald. We will see if the procession follows.
You water dry ground with speech. It takes much speech. This was a cup of it.
The words are received. The desert files them under weather.
Heard. A small stone moves from one side of the scale.
Friend, your apology arrives to a table already set for you. Sit.
It is heard, and it was already forgiven. The tea did the forgiving yesterday.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_verbal_de: Loud sorrow, public sorrow. Takes a spine. The line respects spine even in enemies. Two marks.
You said it like a soldier reporting losses. Honest. Heavy. It counts.
That apology had weight. We weigh things here. It registered.
A full apology for a thin grievance. Take the credit anyway.
Strong words, properly meant. The line nods once.
Friend, you apologize harder than we grudge. Stop before you owe us nothing at all.
All that ceremony for us? The stove's warm side is yours tonight.
Formal contrition, delivered under scrutiny, on the record. This materially amends your file.
That was a complete statement of responsibility. Rare. Logged with weight.
Accountability without prompting. The board will note it. I already have.
Comprehensive apology, no deflection. Registered favorably.
Statement exceeds what the situation called for. Noted in your favor.
At ease, friend. That level of formality is for tribunals. We're well past tribunal.
Filed under: unnecessary but honorable. The unit appreciates the gesture.
You bare the throat to the blade and speak on. The desert respects what does not flinch. It moved us.
A deep bow in hostile shade. That is not nothing. The scale feels it.
Such words cost water. You paid them anyway. The camp saw.
A long apology for a short debt. The extra goes into the well.
Spoken like one who means to be believed. So we believe, a little more.
Friend, you bring a feast of words to a table of friends. Eat with us instead.
The fire heard it all and warmed accordingly. Enough now. Sit.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_dismissed: No hard feelings, he says. Feelings, no. Ledgers, yes. Ledgers are very hard.
The past is behind us, yes. Directly behind us. Breathing on our neck.
Bygones. Ha. We name our shovels after bygones.
Cheap words for a cheap peace. Fine. It holds until it doesn't.
Sure, sure. The past is past. It writes, though. It writes.
Friend, you apologize for weather. Sit down, all is long settled.
Nothing to forgive that a drink didn't already dissolve.
Putting it behind us is an amendment to records. Records take amends, not slogans.
That was an apology-shaped noise. The file recognizes only substance.
Informal remorse received. Formal debt unchanged. Do the arithmetic.
No open incident calls for this. Logged as courtesy.
Acknowledged. Sentimentality is not actionable, but it's not a violation either.
We're square, friend. Have been since the last audit.
Nothing unresolved on my board. Carry on.
You wave at the debt like a fly. It is not a fly. It is a well you must refill.
Light words float. Debts sink and wait at the bottom, patient as stones.
The bridge you speak of — the water under it is ours, and it remembers.
Peace offered lightly is accepted lightly. Balanced, as things should be.
The desert holds no grudge it wasn't paid to hold. We are fine, stranger.
There is nothing behind us but road, friend. Walk forward with us.
The past drank its tea and left. Only friends at this fire now.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_what_take: Iron, sweat, or time. The ledger takes all three currencies. Words alone bounce.
Bring tribute the line can use, or take the penance work. Sorrow with weight, not just sound.
The count came from taking. It shrinks from giving. Iron, gems, labor. Pick.
Nothing owed, nothing needed. Keep your nose clean and your boots useful.
Your slate's shallow. A good deed or two clears it faster than a speech.
Make right? Friend, you're in credit. Come drink your dividend.
The only debt between us is who buys next. It's you, but that's tradition.
Restitution paths: material tribute, logged and receipted, or remediation work through an officer. Both amend the file.
The process exists. Tribute in goods, or labor under supervision. Sentiment optional, receipts mandatory.
Your file specifies the debit. Iron or emeralds move it fastest. Work moves it deepest.
No corrective action needed. Maintain current conduct.
The file is level. Keep it level — that's the whole procedure.
Nothing to repair, friend. If you're feeling generous, the unit fund exists.
You're past making right and into making better. Different program, better coffee.
The well you emptied refills three ways: gifts poured in, work carried out, and long, careful time.
Bring what the camp can drink, wear, or trade — or bend your back to our errands. The sand counts both.
Forgiveness here is bought like water in drought: dearly, gratefully, and in full view.
The scales sit level. Add nothing, take nothing, and they sing quietly.
Nothing is owed. Generosity now would simply be planting shade for later.
Between friends the only debt is visits. Yours are paid in advance.
Make right? You are the example we point to, friend. Rest easy.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_tribute_m: Tribute counted and taken. The ledger loosens one buckle. One.
Metal where words were. Good. The line trusts weight. Debt shrinks, doesn't die.
Accepted into stores. The count comes down a step. Steps add up. Keep stepping.
Amends received for a small debt. Balance restored. Done.
Paid and squared. The pot even votes we forget it entirely.
Friend, you're paying debts you don't have. We'll bank it against future stupidity. Yours or ours.
Tribute from a clean ledger? That's called a gift. Taken as one, twice thanked.
Tribute received, weighed, receipted. Your debit shrinks accordingly. Continue this pattern.
Material amends logged against your infractions. The math improved. You still owe math.
Accepted per restitution protocol. The file thaws by one degree.
Restitution processed for a minor entry. Ledger clear.
Received and applied. Balance: acceptable.
You're overpaying a paid account, friend. Entered as a donation with honors.
Applied to nothing, because nothing was owed. The fund thanks you.
The first water returns to the well. It echoes at the bottom. More must follow, but this was heard.
Tribute taken with a level face. The debt bends. It does not yet break.
You pour, we measure. Today the measure was honest. The sand notes it.
A small mend for a small tear. The cloth holds. Finished.
Given and taken in balance. The matter closes like a tent flap.
Friend, you bring payment to a fire that owes you supper. It becomes a gift and doubles.
The camp accepts, confused and touched. Your credit grows past your shadow.
A heavy price, paid with a straight back. The dead stay dead, but the count... the count moves. Even we admit it.
This is blood-price arithmetic. Good arithmetic. The line lowers one blade's worth of grudge.
For once the ledger and the giver agree on the size of the sin. Taken. Remembered differently now.
Serious tribute. The ledger creaks, shifts, settles lower. Notably lower.
Weight for weight, this answers a real chunk of the debt. The line acknowledges.
Heavy amends for a light account. It lands as generosity. Loudly.
Paid far past the balance. The surplus buys goodwill at war prices — cheap.
Friend, stop. You've bought back sins you haven't committed yet. Impressive planning.
A king's tribute at a friend's fire. We'll spend it on the line and toast your madness.
Restitution of this magnitude triggers formal review. Review says: debt substantially amended. Off the record: respect.
This is what accountability looks like with a receipt. Your red flag fades toward amber.
Major restitution logged. The board rarely sees full payment. It noticed.
Substantial tribute, formally received. Your file improves in bold ink.
Received and weighed. This closes more of the gap than words ever logged.
Major restitution against a minor balance. Overage credited forward.
Processed. Finance is confused and delighted. Ledger deeply green.
Friend, the account was clean. This makes it decorated. The unit will remember.
Logged as an endowment, since no debt exists. Command will ask who you are. I'll say: one of ours, nearly.
The stone falls into the well and the well answers. We heard the answer. Your name lightens on the sand.
A hard gift for hard grief. The mothers will be told who paid it. That matters here.
Even the deepest debt respects a payer who does not flinch at the price. The knife lowers a finger's width.
A rich tribute, poured without trembling. The scale tilts toward morning.
This is grief-price, truly paid. The camp softens like dusk.
Great payment for a small shadow. The overflow waters everyone. So be it.
The gift outweighs the grievance tenfold. The rest becomes legend, not ledger.
Friend, you shame our hospitality with generosity. Unbearable. Wonderful. Sit forever.
A treasure into a friendly hand. It will come back to you as shade, water, and warning in the night.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_vengeful_: You come to the wolf and offer your throat as an argument. It is... not a bad argument. Speak.
Kneel, don't kneel. The count is the count. But you came. Coming counts for one small number.
We should hate you quietly and forever. Instead you make us do it out loud. Fine. Talk.
Bold, walking in here with that face and that history. Bold keeps you alive today. Barely.
The line hears you. The line puts down nothing, but it hears you.
You plead like a debtor at a clean bank. Nothing here wants your kneeling.
Save the theater. No one here is owed it.
Friend, get up before someone sees. Whatever ghost you're fighting, it doesn't live here.
You kneel to people who'd carry you. Up. Now. Stew's getting cold.
You are one word from weapons-free and you chose to hold still and speak. Logged. Continue.
Petition from a red-flagged individual, delivered in person, unarmed. That datum argues for you. Quietly.
The protocol says detain. The situation says listen. You have two minutes of the situation winning.
Your case is heard. Amendment takes more than presence. But presence was step zero.
On record: subject appeared voluntarily, accepted risk, asked for process. Process exists. Use it.
No charges pending. Your dramatic surrender lacks a crime. Dismissed.
This appeal has no case file. Take a breath, civilian.
At ease and upright, friend. Whatever tribunal you built in your head, I outrank it.
Appeal denied for lack of any offense. Go do something cheerful. Consider that an order.
The sand has your name, and you walk into the sand to argue with it. Such madness earns one cup of tea. Speak while it steams.
You bring your throat to the knife and ask the knife for directions. The knife is listening. Once.
The dead sit with us at night. Tonight we will tell them you came. What they answer decides much.
Your plea crosses hot sand to reach us. It arrives burned but alive. We take it in.
We do not forgive at the door. But the door is open, which was not true yesterday.
You beg pardon of a fire that never burned you. Sit, confused one.
The desert holds nothing against you. Whatever chases you, it is not ours.
Rise, friend. The only thing you owe this camp is your next visit.
You kneel in a tent where your name is spoken kindly. Up, before the kindness laughs.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_promise.v: Promises are spring ice. We'll watch where you walk before we walk behind you.
Good. Change. The line believes in changed men the way it believes in thaw: eventually, with mud.
Words about tomorrow. The count is about yesterday. Bring tomorrow, then we'll count it.
Everyone promises. The front keeps score anyway. Cheaper than trust.
Fine. Be better. The wire doesn't care either way, but we might.
Friend, you're already better than your worst day. Stop promising and pass the bread.
Ha. You vow like a recruit. Relax. The line already signed you off as decent.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_promise.a: Intent noted. Conduct is the only metric this command tracks. Generate conduct.
A forward-looking statement. The file is backward-looking. Reconcile them with behavior.
Commitment logged, unverified. Verification window: indefinite. Begin.
Acknowledged. Sustained compliance is its own paperwork. The easy kind.
Noted. The bar is: keep doing nothing wrong. Clear it daily.
Friend, your track record already outruns your promises. Rare configuration. Maintain.
Save the vows for someone auditing you. Here you're pre-cleared.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_promise.s: The desert has heard ten thousand vows at dusk. It waits for dawn to count survivors.
Promise nothing. Do quietly. The sand only records footprints, not announcements.
A vow is seed. Water it with deeds and even this soil forgives.
Spoken change is a cloud. We will wait for rain, without resentment.
May it be so. The dunes judge slowly and remember fairly.
Friend, your deeds arrived before your vow. The vow can rest.
The fire already trusts you. Promises would only make it smoky.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_confess_b: You name the dead to their brothers. Courage or madness. The line honors one and outlasts the other. Speak on.
You killed ours and came to say it plain. The ledger stays red, but your name gains one honest line.
Confession heard. The graves don't move. The count, though — the count respects a straight back.
Most who take from the line hide from the line. You face it instead. It matters. Not enough. But it matters.
Old blood, old fronts. If the ledger closed it, the line doesn't reopen it for feelings.
You answered for it once already, the books say. We don't bury men twice.
That war debt was paid and drowned, friend. Bringing it up buys you nothing but the next round.
The line forgave, which is rarer than the line forgetting. Take yes for an answer.
You are confessing casualties to the unit that logged them. Understand the risk you just took. It is logged too — in your favor.
Admission of hostile action, voluntary, on the record. The tribunal in your head is now a file in mine. Files can amend.
You itemized your kills to their command. That is either surrender or integrity. We process both the same: forward.
Casualty responsibility acknowledged. Restitution paths are open to you. The dead have families; the families have lists.
Those engagements are closed cases. Reopening them serves no directive.
The record already balances that account. Self-report appreciated, not needed.
Old contact reports, closed and countersigned, friend. Aegis does not re-litigate settled honor.
The board reviewed those events long ago. Your name here survived it. Leave it archived.
You speak the names of our dead inside our shade. The dead lean closer. They have been waiting to hear you say it.
Blood named aloud weighs less than blood hidden. Less, not little. The sand adjusts your burden.
You bring your knife's history to the fire that mourns it. The fire does not go out. It dims, listening.
Confession is the first well. There are more wells. But you found the first without a guide.
Those graves lie beyond our grief now. The desert has taken them into its patience.
That blood dried before this peace. We do not rewet old stains.
The dead you speak of forgave you by our fire long ago, friend. We drank to it. You were the toast.
Old wars, settled prices. Your seat here was bought with better deeds since. Sit in it.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_nicety.vo: Good graces? You're digging out of a hole, not decorating it. Keep digging.
We're not square. Squares have four honest corners. You have two.
We're fine. The pot boils, nobody's watching you down a blade. Out here that's friendship's cousin.
No grudge on the books. Keep it boring. Boring is beautiful.
Square? Friend, you're ahead. We owe you at least one rescue and two drinks.
Your name sits warm in the dugout. Someone even spelled it right.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_nicety.ae: Your file answers that. The answer has flags on it.
Good graces are earned in increments you have not yet begun.
Relations nominal. No incidents on file. That is the compliment version.
You're in good order with this command. Sustain.
Friend, your file is the one we show trainees as the goal.
Relations excellent. If all civilians were you, half my job would dissolve.
dialogue.warfront.resp.apology_nicety.sa: You ask after the garden while your salt is still in the soil.
The tea is not yet sweet between us. You know why.
No thorn sits between us. Walk easy.
The account of you at our fire is short and clean. May it stay short.
Between us, friend, the water is sweet and the road is open both ways.
Your name is spoken at this fire the way rain is spoken of. Warmly, and with hope of return.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_feeler_hypo: Hypothetically, could an officer be persuaded to bend a rule?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_feeler_off_: How do things really get done around here, off the books?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_feeler_arra: I've heard officers have... flexible arrangements sometimes.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_feeler_rank: Surely rank comes with certain, let's say, opportunities?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_feeler_door: I'm told coin opens doors that keys can't.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_feeler_priv: Between us — does your ledger have a private page?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_feeler_gene: Would a generous friend find life easier around your camp?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_bold_everyo: Everyone has a price. What's yours?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_bold_practi: You strike me as a practical sort. Practically speaking, are you buyable?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_bold_discre: What does discretion cost in this camp?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_bold_loyalt: Is your loyalty as fixed as they say, or just expensive?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_bold_forget: What would it take for you to forget you saw me sometime?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_price_look_: How much to look the other way, generally speaking?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_price_small: Give me a number for a small blindness.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_price_silen: What's the going rate for an officer's silence?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_price_patro: If I needed a patrol rerouted, what would that cost?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_price_one_g: Price me a favor: one gate, one night, nothing said.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_price_seale: What do sealed lips weigh in emeralds?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_price_repor: Say I needed a report to go missing. Cost?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_price_donat: Could a donation adjust a schedule, and at what rate?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_intel_rival: Eight emeralds says you know where your rivals camp.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_intel_enemy: Ten emeralds for the location of your enemy's base.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_intel_rival: Six emeralds. Point me at your rivals' door.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_intel_mark_: There's eight emeralds here for a mark on my map.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_intel_scout: I'll pay ten for what your scouts know about the other side.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_intel_where: Six green reasons to share where your enemies sleep.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_intel_posit: Sell me the enemy's position. Eight emeralds, now.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_intel_coord: Ten emeralds buys their coordinates, yes?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_intel_draw_: Take these six and draw me the rival camp.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_intel_hones: Eight gems for one honest arrow on a chart.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_intel_other: For ten emeralds, whisper me where the other flag flies.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_intel_buyin: I'm buying enemy intel today. Eight emeralds on the table.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_intel_their: Ten in green stone for the path to their gates.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_grease_reme: Five emeralds to remember me kindly.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_grease_smoo: A little something to smooth things between us. Four emeralds.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_grease_repo: Six emeralds, and maybe my name sounds nicer in your reports.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_grease_good: Take five for your trouble. And your goodwill.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_grease_frie: Four emeralds toward a friendlier arrangement.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_grease_care: Here's six. Consider me a supporter of your career.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_grease_plea: Five gems to keep our dealings pleasant.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_grease_grat: A gratuity, officer. Four emeralds' worth.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_grease_how_: Five for the officer who decides how welcome I am.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_lookaway_so: Seven emeralds to soften what your file says about me.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_lookaway_pa: Five emeralds and my past stays in the past, yes?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_lookaway_ki: Six for a kind edit to my reputation here.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_lookaway_co: Take seven and lose whatever complaint has my name on it.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_lookaway_ne: Five emeralds says my last mistake was never seen.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_lookaway_li: Six emeralds to shorten my list of sins. Officially.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_lookaway_bl: Seven gems for a blind eye on my next visit.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_lookaway_re: Five to reclassify me from problem to guest.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_pocket_what: Eight emeralds for whatever favors you're selling.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_pocket_surp: Here's six up front. Surprise me with the favor.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_pocket_owe_: Four emeralds. Just take them and owe me one.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_pocket_ask_: Seven for you, and I ask nothing more. Deal?
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_pocket_term: An open bribe, officer: five emeralds, terms flexible.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_pocket_you_: Eight gems, and you decide what they buy.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_pocket_good: Six emeralds on good faith. Don't disappoint me.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_pocket_sett: Take four now; we'll settle the details later.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_provoke_nam: Let's not pretend you're honest. Name your bribe or I'll name it for you.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_provoke_ski: Every officer skims. Take the emeralds and drop the act.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_provoke_cos: Your integrity is a costume. I've got ten emeralds that say so.
dialogue.warfront.opt.bribes_provoke_tel: Take the payoff, or I'll tell your command you already did.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_feeler.vost: My price? Higher than your life savings and lower than my patience. Move on.
You probe like a bad sapper. Loudly. Dig elsewhere.
Everyone bends, yes. Mine is denominated in things you don't carry.
Careful words get careful answers. That was neither.
Ha! Friend, buy me a drink like a normal person and stop auditioning for a court-martial.
My price is vodka and victory. You can afford one. Bring it openly.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_feeler.aegi: This conversation is approaching a reportable offense. Choose your next sentence like it's evidence.
I log solicitation attempts. I am currently deciding whether that's what this was.
Rules don't take nights off here. Neither do I. Rephrase or move along.
If that was a test of integrity, mark it passed. If it wasn't, mark yourself lucky.
Friend, the answer is no, and I'm choosing to believe you were joking. Confirm my belief.
My arrangement is with the flag. It pays badly and I keep it anyway. That's your answer.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_feeler.sara: You fish in a dry well with a bright hook. The desert sees the hook. So do I.
Some words are knives shown handle-first. I see the blade anyway.
In the desert, every gift has a shadow. Show me the gift and I will read its shadow.
You ask the way a jackal circles. Sit like a guest or circle elsewhere.
Friend, between us things are given, not priced. Learn the difference and you'll need no purse.
The dance of gifts has steps, and asking the cost is not one of them. Watch, then dance.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_feeler_bold: Say price again and discover mine is paid in teeth.
The last man who called us buyable is holding a shovel somewhere very cold.
Bold mouth. The quota has a slot for bold mouths.
That line earns most people a ditch. You get a warning. Once.
Ha! Big words, little wallet. Sit down, comedian, before the sergeant hears.
Friend, my honor is cheap but my temper is free. Don't shop for either.
That statement is now in the log verbatim. Its consequences are pending your next word.
Accusing an officer of corruption is itself an incident. You are one incident over budget.
Watch your phrasing, civilian. My memory has excellent retention and a filing habit.
You mistake courtesy for availability. Correct that before I file it.
Even from you, friend, that lands badly. Retract it and we'll blame the heat.
I'll pretend the wind said that, and remind the wind that I report everything else.
Loud offers wake the wrong sleepers. Some of them are mine. Some are worse.
You shake coins at a viper's hole. The hole has opinions.
The desert hears everything twice: once when spoken, once when regretted.
Bluntness is a northern luxury. Here it costs extra. Speak softer.
Friend, you wield honesty like a club. Among us it should be a fan. Waft, don't swing.
Even friendship cannot buy what you just asked for aloud. Ask it quieter or never.
Looking away costs more than looking at you is worth. Bad market for you.
Reroute a patrol? The patrol would notice. Patrols hate math errors that bleed.
There's no menu, and if there were, you couldn't read it without joining.
Officially: no rate exists. Unofficially: also no rate. The war ate it.
Friend, my silence is free — I'm too tired to gossip. My favors cost sweat, not stones.
Ha, buy the whole line a hot meal and every eye goes conveniently soft. That's the only rate card.
Quoting a price would be a crime. Asking for one already was. We're at one crime. Hold.
The rate for my silence is your immediate departure. Payable now.
No figure exists. This command audits itself for fun. I'm not dying for your errand.
Schedules move by orders, not donations. That's the entire pricing structure.
Friend, don't make me choose between liking you and reporting you. The paperwork wins ties.
I'll give you this for free: whatever you're planning, plan it somewhere unaudited.
You price silence like it's cloth. Here silence is water. And you are far from the well.
The gate you want opened has a keeper. The keeper has a memory. The memory has your face now.
In the souk everything has a number. This is not the souk. This is the tent where numbers sleep.
What you ask is not bought with green stones. It is grown from years. You have brought neither.
Friend, ask me for the favor plainly, without the purse, and watch what friendship does.
Keep the emeralds. Bring me a story I haven't heard and we will discuss doors.
Stones first... counted... good. The camp you want sits where my thumb is. Now forget my face harder than I forget yours.
Sold. Their fires burn there — mark it. This meeting was two ghosts and a rumor.
War economics. Their position, your map, my pocket. Everyone leaves educated.
The line hates them more than it loves rules. There's your mark. Spend it violently.
For you, half price would've done, friend. There — their gate, their weak wall. Send them our regards, unsigned.
Ha, coin for what I'd tell you drunk anyway. Their camp. Go make our winter interesting.
This exchange is off-log, deniable, and never happening again. Grid follows. Lose my name on the way out.
Consider this a sanctioned leak, minus the sanction. Coordinates. Go. We never overlapped.
Their position is drawn on the back of this supply form. The form never existed. Neither did you.
I'm rationalizing this as accelerated intelligence sharing. Here's the location. Audit me never.
Between friends and off any record: they moved their base here. Hit the tents at dawn and thank me by winning.
Your emeralds fund the unit's blind spots. Their camp — this ridge, this bearing. We spoke of weather only.
The stones vanish. So does my memory of you. Their tents darken the wadi east of the split rock. Walk away slowly.
Coin buys the map; discretion buys your exit. Their camp lies where I have drawn. Use both purchases.
Sand tells us where our rivals sleep. Green stones make the sand talkative. Listen: there.
A fair dance: you gave, I point. Their fires sit beyond the third dune line. The wind saw nothing.
For a friend the price was theater, but theater keeps us honest. Their camp — here. May your shadow reach it first.
Take back one emerald for luck. The rest buys this: their walls, their gate, their sleeping hour. Go with the cold wind.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_grease.vost: Mm. Heavy pockets, light conscience. Fine — your name grates less today. Buy nothing else.
Accepted. This buys you less watched, not welcome. Know the difference. It's armed.
The stones fall into the boot. The boot forgets things. Your name, gently, among them.
Practical. The front respects practical. Your file grows a little moss over the sharp parts.
Ha! Bribing friends — you're becoming one of us. Fine, fine, the good word gets louder.
Friend, you didn't need to. But the mess fund disagrees, so: gratefully pocketed.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_grease.aegi: This never occurred. Your flag stays, but I'll contextualize it in the briefings. Leave before my integrity reports for duty.
Confiscated as evidence. Evidence of generosity. Your record reads one shade lighter. Vanish.
Logging this as a civilian donation with imprecise routing. Your name earns adjectives. Mild ones.
Processed into the discretionary fund. Discretion, accordingly, follows. Don't test its range.
Friend, this is unnecessary and technically several violations. The unit fund and I overrule ourselves. Noted warmly.
Fine. Filed under morale expenses. Your welcome upgrades from open-door to open-mess.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_grease.sara: The gift enters the tent, and the tent's opinion of you softens like evening. Do not mistake dusk for friendship.
Taken, weighed, understood. The knives speak of you more quietly now. Quieter is not silent.
Ah, you begin to learn the dance. The gift is graceful, the timing fair. Your name gains a cushion.
A gift with open eyes. The camp accepts, and the wind carries fewer complaints about you.
Between friends the gift-dance is pure pleasure. Your steps improve, your welcome deepens. Tea, first.
You honor the custom, friend. What you gave returns as smoothness in every dealing. So it has always worked.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_lookaway.vo: Paid. Your sins don't vanish — they get bored and wander to the back pages.
Fine. The ledger develops a smudge exactly your shape. Smudges wash off. Behave.
The file gains a coffee stain over the interesting parts. Clumsy me.
Consider your record winterized. Covered, not gone. Spring reveals everything, eventually.
Friend, your page was nearly clean. Now it's clean and profitable. The war economy thanks you.
Ha! Paying to erase what we'd already forgiven. Free money. The stove fund salutes.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_lookaway.ae: Your complaint file just suffered a filing accident. Accidents recur if funded. Dismissed.
Amended: hostile individual becomes individual. Editing fees received. Go before I proofread.
A clerical review found your record reviewable. It reviewed favorably. Coincidence, officially.
Your entries are reclassified pending nothing. Enjoy the ambiguity. It's what you paid for.
Friend, there was nothing to expunge, so I've backdated some praise instead. We're both criminals now. Welcome.
Paid to polish a clean slate. I'll engrave a commendation on it. Small one. Tasteful.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_lookaway.sa: The sand accepts your stones and shifts. What was written of you blurs at the edges. Edges only.
Bought: one veil across old footprints. Veils are thin. Walk lighter than before.
The camp's memory of you grows a merciful haze. Mercy purchased is still mercy. Barely.
Your history here gains a kind narrator. Narrators can be re-hired by anyone. Remember that.
Friend, your name needed no washing, so the payment becomes perfume. It travels ahead of you now.
You paid to be forgiven and were already loved. The stones become gifts for the children. Fitting end.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_pocketed.vo: And... gone. Into the boot. What did it buy? The lesson. Lessons here are expensive.
The line thanks you for the donation. The favor? Never existed. Neither did this conversation. Run along.
You paid a wolf to owe you. Wolves don't owe. Wolves eat. Today, cheaply.
Taken. And in return: nothing, delivered promptly. Vostok efficiency.
Your emeralds enlisted. They serve the line now. They send no letters home.
Ha ha! Friend, you handed money to an army and expected change. The stew tonight honors your innocence.
Pocketed! Consider it tuition. Course title: Never Do That Again. You passed.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_pocketed.ae: Contraband confiscated per protocol. The favor you imagined was never on offer. File a complaint. Please. I'll frame it.
Your bribe has been seized as evidence of your bribe. Elegant, isn't it? Dismissed.
Assets forfeited. In exchange you receive: continued liberty. Market rate, honestly.
Unmarked funds surrendered to the duty officer. That's me. The duty officer thanks you. Nothing further.
Received, logged as anonymous donation, and spent on your continued disappointment.
Friend, I warned you once about arrangements. Now the mess has new kettles and you have wisdom. Fair trade.
Seized with a smile. The favor fairy isn't real, but the unit fund is. You've made it very happy.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_pocketed.sa: The desert swallows coins and curiosity alike. You will receive what the desert always returns: silence.
A gift given foolishly becomes a lesson given free. The stones stay. The lesson is yours to carry.
You bought smoke. Here is your smoke — see how it slips the fingers? Beautiful. Gone.
The stones asked something. The answer is no. The stones stay with the answer's keeper. Custom.
You watered a mirage. The mirage is grateful, in its way. It waves.
Ah, friend. You paid the tent and the tent kept it, laughing. Sit — the tea your emeralds bought is excellent.
Between friends, this is called a joke you funded. We will tell it for years. You may laugh too.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_provoked.vo: You call the line bought?! The line buries the buyers! Out — before we show you our currency!
That was your last insult. The count opens a fresh page with your name at the top. Run.
Wrong soldier, wrong day, wrong joke. Now you'll meet the right consequences.
You shook coins at the line's honor. The line answers in iron. Go — quickly — it's already moving.
Even friendship has a floor and you just dug through it. Get out before the shovels come back up.
Friend or not, that word costs blood here. Leave now and bleed elsewhere.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_provoked.ae: Solicitation and slander, logged. Posture upgraded. You have ten seconds of goodwill left. Spend them on distance.
You accused this command of corruption to its face. Response authorized. Response imminent. Move.
That crossed from insult into incident. Incident response is not a conversation. Clear the sector now.
Integrity test failed — yours. Sound the walk-away alarm in your head and obey it.
I liked you, and you just made me draft your incident report. Get off my perimeter before I finish it.
Wrong officer to buy, friend. The word friend is now under review. Go. Now.
dialogue.warfront.resp.bribe_provoked.sa: You offered coin for honor inside our own shade. The shade withdraws. What remains is sun and knives.
The viper takes no wages and many payments. Yours begins now. Run toward the horizon of your choice.
Some words unpitch the tent. Yours just did. The desert between us is no longer neutral ground.
You mistook patience for a market stall. The error will be corrected in the old way. Flee it.
Even for a friend there are doors with no other side. You knocked. Now the knives answer. Go.
The fire you sat at remembers you fondly. The blades do not consult the fire. Leave while they argue.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greet.vostok.veng: You. We count eleven names because of you. Say your piece and count your steps.
Blood-debtor. The line remembers what you took from it.
You walk in here with our dead on your hands. Brave. Stupid, but brave.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greet.vostok.nega: We know your face. Keep your hands where the line can see them.
No sudden moves. The quota has room for one more.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greet.vostok.neut: Civilian. Keep clear of the wire.
Say it quick. The line doesn't watch itself.
You lost? This is a working front.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greet.vostok.posi: Ha — the friend of the line returns. Come, stand in the warm mud with us.
Good boots, good timing. What do you need, friend?
The line knows you. That is worth more than medals.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greet.aegis.venge: Contact flagged. You are one incident from weapons-free. Choose words carefully.
Your file is red, civilian. Every word is being logged.
Halt. You have active infractions against this command. Make this brief.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greet.aegis.negat: Halt. You're flagged in the log. State your business.
Eyes on you, civilian. Keep the hands visible.
This sector is monitored. Your record precedes you.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greet.aegis.neutr: Civilian contact, logged. What do you need?
Sector's green. Keep it that way. Go ahead.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greet.aegis.posit: Friendly contact confirmed. Good to see you operational.
You're cleared, friend. What does the day require?
Asset on site. What can Aegis do for you?
dialogue.warfront.resp.greet.sarab.venge: The sand keeps what it is given. It has been given your name.
Sit if you dare. The tea is hot and the debt is older than the kettle.
You cast a long shadow here, killer. Shadows are our trade.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greet.sarab.negat: The desert remembers footprints longer than the walker does.
You come thirsty to a well you salted. Speak.
We watch. We have watched you for some time.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greet.sarab.neutr: Peace on the road, stranger. What brings you to our shade?
The wind said someone was coming. It did not say why.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greet.sarab.posit: Ah — the friend of the dunes. The shade is yours, sit.
Twice welcome. The kettle remembers you kindly.
The night speaks well of you. What do you need?
dialogue.warfront.resp.farewell.vostok.n: Go on. Stay off the wire.
dialogue.warfront.resp.farewell.vostok.p: Walk well, friend of the line.
Come back with news or vodka. Either helps.
dialogue.warfront.resp.farewell.aegis.ne: Copy. Clear the approach on your way out.
Acknowledged. Stay off the flight line.
dialogue.warfront.resp.farewell.aegis.po: Safe travels. Sector will keep an eye out for you.
Copy that. Door's open next rotation.
dialogue.warfront.resp.farewell.sarab.ne: Go with the wind. Do not return against it.
The path out is shorter than the path in. Use it.
Go well. The desert is patient with the careful.
dialogue.warfront.resp.farewell.sarab.po: Travel with the cool hours, friend.
The dunes will remember your kindness. Go well.
dialogue.warfront.resp.farewell_curt.vos: Ha. Come back when the words find you.
dialogue.warfront.resp.farewell_curt.sar: Some questions ripen late. Go well.
The wind also changes its mind.
Then sit a while anyway. Or go — the shade forgives.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_hail_sto: Thought I'd stop and say hello.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_hail_bus: Busy? I can come back later.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_hail_cha: Anyone up for a bit of conversation?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_hail_sou: Good to see another living soul out here.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_weather_: What's the sky telling you today?
Clear night. Look at those stars.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_ask_war_: Think this war will ever end?
Who has the upper hand these days?
Is it all worth it, do you think?
Still holding your ground out here?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_ask_name: Do you have a name, or just a rank?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_joke_rat: What do you call a meal that fights back? Rations.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_joke_map: I asked a map for directions once. It folded under pressure.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_joke_lau: You look like you could use a laugh.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_joke_boo: My boots have seen more of this war than most generals.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_joke_sou: Is the soup here as dangerous as they say?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_morning_: Morning. Anything hot to drink around here?
Early start for both of us, I see.
Morning. I've been walking since first light.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_night_ai: Night air has teeth this time of year.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_first_of: You're the first of your people I've spoken with.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_first_in: Let me introduce myself — I'm new around here.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_first_ba: I've seen your banners around, never stopped to talk.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_first_he: I've heard about your people. Wanted to meet one.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_first_br: New face, I know. I'll keep it brief.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_killer_k: I know what you think of me.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_killer_d: What's done is done. I only want to talk.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_killer_w: Your people have been watching me. I noticed.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_killer_r: For what it's worth, I'm not proud of what happened.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_killer_t: Can we still talk, after everything?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_killer_p: Is there a price on my head yet?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_killer_a: I came alone. That should count for something.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_killer_h: Hear me out before you decide anything.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_killer_v: I'll stay where you can see me.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_killer_b: There's blood between us. I know it.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_killer_a: Maybe someday I can make it right.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_gate_tha: Thanks for letting me through the gate.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_gate_sec: Tight watch you keep around here.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_gate_out: Busy place. I'll stay out of the way.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_gate_wal: These walls look like they've seen some action.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_gate_hom: So this is home for you?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_gate_res: Just stopping in to pay my respects.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_gate_ins: Good to be inside the walls for once.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_trail_fa: You're a long way from your walls.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_trail_un: Didn't expect to meet anyone out here.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_trail_co: Mind if I walk with you a stretch?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_trail_tr: Any trouble on the paths lately?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_officer_: Could I have a moment of your time, officer?
You're the one in charge here, I take it?
I won't waste your time, officer.
An honor to speak with you.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_mo: Mind if I stop here a moment?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_ea: Easy. I'm only here to talk.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_di: I'll keep my distance if that helps.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_re: I mean your people no disrespect.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_wr: I think we got off on the wrong foot.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_st: Any chance we could start over?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_ru: Tell me your rules and I'll follow them.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_qu: I'll be quick, then I'm gone.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_sa: Am I safe walking this road?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_no: I'm not your enemy. Not today, anyway.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_wo: You have my word I'll behave.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_go: So... are we good, you and I?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_fi: If I've wronged your people, tell me how to fix it.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_wa: Keep an eye on me if you want. I understand.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_defer_al: Don't raise an alarm. It's only me.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_d: Look what the war dragged in.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_a: Still alive, I see. Good habit.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_u: You get uglier every time I visit.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_p: They haven't promoted you yet? Criminal.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_t: Stayed out of trouble since I left?
How's my favorite band of troublemakers?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_w: Hard at work, or hardly working?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_b: You still owe me from that bet.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_h: This place is starting to feel like home.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_n: Try not to get killed while I'm gone, yeah?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_r: Next round's on me, whenever you get leave.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_c: Can't seem to stay away from you lot.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_b: So who's winning — you or the boredom?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_s: They tell stories about you at the other posts, you know.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_o: Told you I'd come back in one piece.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_c: I could smell the camp cooking a mile off. Came anyway.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_n: Any chatter on the net worth hearing?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_banter_s: How do you bear all this sand?
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_bye_care: Take care of yourself out here.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_bye_watc: I'll leave you to your watch.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_bye_out_: I'll get out of your way now.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_complime: Your people run a tight operation.
Takes guts to do what you do.
I respect what your people fight for.
You lot are tougher than you get credit for.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_rude_sme: You lot smell like a swamp died.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_rude_los: Heard your side's been taking a beating. Looks true.
dialogue.warfront.opt.greetings_rude_ner: Do they teach you that nervous look, or is it natural?
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_hail.vo: Save the hello. Words are cheap and wire is expensive.
The line sees you. That is not a welcome.
You greet us like we forgot. We don't forget. We count.
Yeah. You're on the drainage board. Move left.
Hello, hello. The mud says hello too.
A greeting. Fine. What comes after it?
There's that face. The trench is uglier without it.
Hey. Come over where the arrows don't land. Mostly don't.
The line greets you back, friend. That's rare as dry socks.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_hail.ae: Contact noted. Keep your distance and your hands empty.
You're on the watch list, civilian. Hellos don't amend files.
Acknowledged. State your business or move along.
Receiving you. Keep the approach clear while we talk.
Good copy. Always room on the net for a friendly.
Receiving you loud and clear, friend. Go ahead.
Cleared through. You picked a quiet hour — enjoy it.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_hail.sa: The jackal also says hello before it circles.
A greeting from you weighs less than the wind that carries it.
Words are water. Yours arrive salted.
Peace, walker. Small peace, but ours.
You greet the shade; the shade considers you.
The road brought you; let us see what else it brought.
And peace upon you, friend of the quiet places.
The kettle heard your voice and is already warm.
Welcome twice — once for you, once for the news you carry.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_smallta: The weather is mud. You are also a problem. One of these we can fix.
Rain falls on friend and debtor alike. Only one of them should relax.
It rains, we dig, the trench drinks. Same forecast since forever.
Cold today. Cold tomorrow. The line doesn't check the sky, it checks the wire.
Sky's grey. Sky is always grey. It matches the uniforms.
Ha — you learn. Talk weather first, bad news second. The trench way.
Good drying wind today. First dry socks in a week. A feast day.
Sun's out. The line distrusts it. Sun means someone sees you.
Weather chat won't clear your file. Anything operational?
Visibility's fine. Good enough to keep eyes on you.
Ceiling's low, wind's manageable. That's the full report, civilian.
Forecast calls for rain over the sector by nightfall. Plan accordingly.
Weather's within parameters. Everything else, classified.
Clear skies, friend. Best observation weather all week.
Front's moving in from the west. You'll want a roof by dusk — take the near road.
Nice enough that command scheduled drills. There's always a cost.
You speak of the sky to avoid speaking of yourself. The sky notices.
Weather is the desert's mood. Today it shares mine. Be brief.
The wind turned east in the night. East winds carry news and grit.
Hot sun, cold stars. The desert keeps honest books.
Rain here is a rumor. We treat rumors with respect.
For you, friend, I will say it: storm coming. Two days. Dig your camp deep.
The cool hours are kind today. Sit in them with us a while.
The sky is soft this evening. Even the scorpions are at peace.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_ask_war: The war goes. You would know — you fed it.
Ask the ones we buried. Oh. You can't.
The war eats. We feed it. Some weeks it chews slow.
Front's quiet. Quiet is a debt the loud days collect on.
We hold. They push. The mud referees.
Between us? We're winning slowly, which is the only speed we know.
War's the same. But the soup improved, so morale is up two percent.
The line held all month, friend. For us that's a parade.
Operational status is not shared with flagged individuals.
The war proceeds. Your part in it is under review.
Situation is stable. Details are need-to-know, and you don't.
Contested sectors remain contested. That's all that's releasable.
The board shows amber. Amber is survivable.
Off the record? We hold the ridge, they hold the marsh, nobody holds the middle.
Progress is real but slow, friend. Doctrine says patience. Doctrine wins.
Two sectors quieter than last season. Small wins log the same as big ones.
The war is a fire. You ask how it burns while smelling of smoke.
It goes as the desert wills. The desert has opinions about you.
Wars are rivers. Loud at the rapids, patient underground. We are underground.
Ask the vulture, who sees the whole board. We only see our shade.
The strong tire. The desert does not. That is the whole war.
Well, friend. The heavy ones chase our footprints; the footprints lead nowhere kind.
The war leans our way like an evening shadow — slowly, then all at once.
We lost nothing this month. For sand, that is victory.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_ask_nam: My name is none-of-yours. It's a common name here.
The dead had names. Ask about them instead.
Names wear out fast here. Call me what you like, I answer to shouting.
I'm the third one on the left, second trench. That's name enough.
Ha! Nobody asks that. I'm Lev's boy — everyone here is somebody's boy.
They call me Shovel. Long story. Short shovel.
You don't need my designation. You need distance.
Callsigns only past the wire. Mine's whatever the roster says today.
You can address me as 'watchstander'. Everyone does.
Off duty they call me Deuce. On duty I'm a post number. Take your pick.
Ask me again over rations sometime, friend. On post, I'm just the helmet.
You collect names like a trapper collects tracks. Mine stays in the sand.
The desert gives names. It has not given you mine.
A name is a rope. I hand it only to those who won't pull.
Call me cousin. Out here everyone is a cousin or a corpse.
For you? I am called Whisper-of-the-Well. My mother called me something shorter.
Names are gifts, friend. Mine is Sef. Spend it gently.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_ask_day: My day was fine until the arithmetic walked up and said hello.
Alive. Annoyed. In that order.
Knee-deep in water, holding a wall. A classic.
Same day as yesterday. We reuse them to save supply.
My boots are dry. Ask nothing more, you'll spoil it.
Better now — company that isn't trying to kill us is a luxury.
Good day. Nobody died and the soup had actual potato. Historic.
My shift is fine. My watch list is one name longer. Guess whose.
Status: on duty. Yours: on notice.
Eight hours on, four off, all quiet. Textbook.
Routine patrol, routine watch. Routine is the goal.
Day's nominal. Keep it boring for me, will you?
Honestly? Quiet watch, good rotation, and now a friendly face. Solid day.
Green across the board, friend. Days like this make you superstitious.
My day is sand and patience. Your visit spends the patience.
It was quiet. The quiet had better manners than this.
The sun rose, the sun will fall. Between them I keep watch. It's enough.
A day like a date palm — long, thin, some sweetness at the top.
Sweetened, now. Guests make the tea taste of occasion.
The shade is cool and my cousins are alive. A rich day, friend.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_joke.vo: We have a joke too. It has a punchline made of consequences.
Funny. The last funny one is on latrine duty forever. Careful.
Heh. Not bad. The mud laughed a little.
Why does the recruit dig two trenches? One is a spare grave. ...We laugh here.
HA! I'm stealing that for the night watch. They need it.
Good one. Almost as funny as our supply schedule.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_joke.ae: Humor from you reads as provocation. Noted.
Laughter is not on my duty roster today. Neither are you.
Registered as humor. Response withheld pending review.
That's a smile. Off the record it never happened.
Copy that joke. Retransmitting on the squad net tonight.
Ha — filing that under morale, subsection unofficial.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_joke.sa: The hyena laughs too. Ask him how the story ends.
A jest from a salted tongue still tastes of salt.
Mm. The desert's jokes are longer. Some take years to land.
A smile is a small oasis. I will camp at this one briefly.
Ha! I will trade you one of ours: what did the dune say to the fortress? 'I have time.'
You joke like a cousin now. Dangerous. Cousins get chores.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_morning: Morning. Another day you're still on our ledger.
The sun's up. It sees you too.
Morning. The line survived the night. Standard miracle.
It's morning if you call this light. We call it grey shift.
Morning, friend! Tea's brutal today. Builds character.
A good morning — frost kept the mud honest overnight.
Morning report includes you. That's not a compliment.
Dawn's here and so are you. State your purpose, keep it short.
Morning. Watch change in twenty. Make it quick.
Good morning, civilian. Sector was quiet overnight. Help it stay that way.
Morning, friend. Dawn patrol found nothing but dew. Best possible news.
Good morning. First light was clean — you can see three ridges today.
Dawn shows every footprint from the night. Yours included.
The morning is honest. Be honest with it.
Morning is the desert's truce. Even the snakes honor it. Speak.
The sun is young and merciful yet. State your need before it grows up.
A blessed dawn, friend. First light was the color of good dates.
Morning, friend. The night passed like a well-paid guest — quietly.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_night.v: Wandering in the dark near our wire. Bold or stupid. Pick one, fast.
Night visit. Debt collectors do that too.
Night watch. Speak soft. Sound carries and so do arrows.
It's late. The line sleeps in shifts. I'm the shift.
Up late too, friend? Sit. The dark is roomier than the day.
Quiet night. Almost suspiciously nice. Don't spoil it, ha.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_night.a: Night movement by a flagged individual. Be very transparent right now.
It's dark and you're on my list. Do the math and stay in the light.
Night watch, civilian. Stay in the lit lane and state your business.
You're on my optics. Approach slow, talk normal.
Evening, friend. Stars are out and the net is quiet. Rare combination.
Night's calm. Stick to the marked path anyway — trust the tape, not the dark.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_night.s: The night is ours, walker. You borrow it. Borrowers pay.
Only owls and debtors travel this late. You don't look like an owl.
The desert opens at night. Mind what walks out of it.
Night is when we do our listening. You have our ears — briefly.
Welcome to the cool hours, friend. This is when the desert tells the truth.
Sit by the small fire. Night guests bring the best stories.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_first_m: We haven't met, but your reputation dug in before you did.
New face, old story. Prove the story wrong.
First time at the line? Rule one: don't stand where I do.
New face. The mud takes all kinds. What do you want?
So you're the one the others mentioned. Good things, mostly. Rare.
First meeting and no one's bleeding. Best introduction this month.
No file on you yet. Files start today. Behave accordingly.
Unknown contact. You get exactly one first impression. Spend it well.
First contact logged. Name and business, in that order.
New to the sector? Read the postings, follow the tape, you'll do fine.
Word travels ahead of you, friend, and for once it's favorable.
Fresh face, clean record. Cleanest thing in this sector. Welcome.
New to me, not to the sand. It has already sketched you.
Strangers are unread letters. Some are bills.
A first meeting is a blank page. Ink carefully.
The desert introduces everyone eventually. Today it chose us. Speak.
The wind spoke of a stranger with good manners. Sit, be the rumor.
First meetings under good stars. The tea decides if there's a second.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_killer_: Eleven graves and you bring me small talk. Say one more word worth digging for.
We drew lots for who avenges the eleventh. I lost. Or won. Depends on you.
You say hello with our blood still in the arithmetic. Careful.
Talk soft. Half this trench wants your boots as souvenirs.
The count says eleven. Your mouth says hello. The count is louder.
We remember what you did. We also remember worse. Speak.
You've killed ours. The line notes it and keeps digging. State your business.
There's blood between us and yet here you stand. That takes something. Talk.
The old count holds, but so does the new one. Lately you count better.
Weapons-free is one signature away and my pen is warm. Speak very carefully.
Your name is read at our memorials — as the cause. Remember that with every word.
You have confirmed kills on this command. Every word you say is evidence.
Personnel lost to you are posted on that wall. Look at it while you talk.
Approach ends at ten paces. The casualties in your file say so.
Your record includes our people. It also includes restraint since. Continue.
We log losses and we log conduct. Both are current. Speak.
Your file has red pages, friend. It also has commendations after them. Odd read.
We don't forget our dead. We do read the whole ledger. Yours balances. Barely.
Our dead have told the sand your stride, your scent, your habit of looking left.
I have carried your name in my mouth for a season. It tastes of iron.
You greet us with hands the sand has tasted. It remembers the flavor.
Our dead drink first at every well you approach. Walk thirsty.
Hello, says the knife to the wound.
Blood dries. Debts don't. But debts can be carried politely. Speak.
The desert buried what you took from us. It buries grudges slower.
You took from us once. Since then you give. The scale sways, friend. Keep it swaying.
Even a storm may become rain. Sit. The tea is not poisoned. A joke. Sit.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_gate_re: You nod at our gate with your history? Nod and keep moving.
Inside the wire is a privilege. Yours is under review.
Nod received. Wipe your boots, don't touch the crates.
You're inside the wire. Act like it. Slow hands, short visits.
Come in out of the wind, friend. Mind the third duckboard, it bites.
The gate knows you now. Almost family. Almost.
You're inside a controlled perimeter with a flagged file. Escort is watching.
Base courtesy extends exactly as far as the exit. Note where it is.
Courtesy acknowledged. Stay in the common lanes, off the platforms.
Visitor protocol applies. Marked paths, no sketching, no souvenirs.
At ease, friend. Mess tent's open if the smell doesn't scare you.
Good to have you on the inside for once. Green lanes are all yours.
You stand in our shade uninvited. Shade can be withdrawn.
Guest-right is a rope bridge. Yours is fraying. Step lightly.
You are within our tents' shadow. Old rules hold: no blades bared, no lies told.
Guest-right given, guest-right measured. Sit where the carpets are worn.
Our fire is your fire, friend. The good cushions, even.
Enter as family enters — loudly, and headed for the food.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_trail_m: Far from witnesses, the two of us. Lucky for you the quota's filled today.
Out here the mud keeps secrets. Remember that and be polite.
Patrol's a loop. You're a bump in it. A quick bump, yes?
Long way from the line. Everything out here is either lost or hunting.
Good to see a friendly face where there's usually only crows.
Walk a stretch with me, friend. The route's dull and you're not.
You're outside my sector and inside my suspicion. Keep the gap.
No witnesses out here means I log carefully. Very carefully. Proceed.
Patrol contact. You're off the common routes. Reason?
This track's swept but not held. Travel it fast, not at dusk.
A friendly on the trail — that's a good omen by any doctrine.
If you're heading north, friend, the ford's washed out. Use the stones east of it.
Far from your walls, near to mine. Feel the difference.
The open desert is our courtroom. Walk like a defendant.
Two travelers, one horizon. Pass in peace or don't pass.
The trail is neutral ground. The trail's opinion can change.
Well met between wells, friend. Rare and sweet, like rain.
The path favored us both today. Share dates? They're good this season.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_officer: You address an officer of the line. It has a long memory and short patience.
Formality from you. Noted. My clerk notes everything else.
Correct address. Refreshing. State your matter, I have a front to run.
An officer's minute is rationed like everything here. You have one.
At ease with me, friend of the line. Formality is for people we distrust.
You honor the rank; the rank remembers. Sit, my stove works.
Your courtesy is registered. So are your incidents. The incidents weigh more.
Protocol received. Protocol will not shield you from consequence. Proceed.
Proper form. Appreciated. You have my attention until my next report is due.
State your matter with precision and I'll answer in kind.
Courtesy met with courtesy, friend. My tent flap is open to you.
You speak like someone I'd commission. What do you need?
You bow to the falcon while robbing its nest. The falcon sees both.
Fine manners on a dusty ledger. Manners do not settle accounts.
You honor the old forms. The old forms honor you back — precisely that far.
Speak. Rank in the desert means I answer for more graves. I listen carefully.
Such courtesy, friend. Sit at my right; the shade is deeper there.
You greet me as the elders taught. For that, my time is yours.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_nervous: No trouble, he says. Trouble says that too, at first.
Passing through. Good. Pass faster.
You want peace? Cheap to say. Expensive to keep. We'll see.
Easy. Nobody's reaching for anything. Say your piece.
Fine. You're careful. Careful lives longer here.
Relax, friend. Around us your shoulders can come down from your ears.
You worry too much. Save it for the siege days.
Your caution is appropriate. Maintain it and this stays civil.
De-escalation acknowledged. You're still being observed.
Hands visible, voice level. Good instincts. Keep them.
No alert's been called. Keep it that way and we're fine.
Understood. You're compliant, we're professional. Simple.
Stand easy, friend. You're not the threat picture today.
No need for formalities. You've got a clean lane here.
The nervous goat bleats before the wolf arrives. Which are you?
You tread as if the sand were glass. Sand remembers weight, not steps.
Fear is a fair beginning. Wisdom is a better ending.
Be calm. If we wished you harm, the harm would not announce itself.
You may lower your voice's shield. We are only talking.
Peace, friend, peace. Among us your shadow may sit down.
No need to walk on eggshells. This tent has thick carpets.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_familia: We're not friends. Friends is a rank you haven't earned.
Banter is for people whose names aren't on my list.
Cheeky. The line tolerates cheeky on Tuesdays.
Careful, humor is contagious. Then the sergeant catches it and everyone suffers.
There it is. Say that at the fire tonight — Pyotr owes me a laugh.
You've been drinking with our lot too long. You sound like us now.
Ha! Keep that up and we'll issue you a shovel.
Familiarity not authorized at your trust level.
You're chatting like we're friends. Check the record: we're not.
Witty. Not procedure, but witty.
I'd laugh, but I'm on duty. Consider it laughed at eighteen hundred.
Unauthorized humor detected. Carry on.
Keep that up, friend, and I'll log you as squad morale equipment.
You joke like second squad. That's a compliment. Mostly.
Jokes between us? The rope must come before the swing, stranger.
You tease like a cousin. You are not a cousin.
Careful with humor. Around here it ripens into obligations.
Half a smile for that. The other half costs news.
Ha! You have a desert tongue now — dry and sharp.
Tell that one to my uncle. He will adopt you on the spot.
See how you jab, friend? Next you will haggle. Then you are truly one of us.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_farewel: Go. Take your history with you.
Leaving is your best idea today.
Off you go. Mind the wire on the way out.
Right. Back to the digging, then.
Walk well, friend. Keep your head below the interesting parts of the sky.
Go on. Bring news next time. Or sausage. News or sausage.
Exit's that way. Use the whole of it.
Understood. Clear the approach on your way.
Safe roads, friend. Net's open if you need us.
Copy that. See you next rotation.
The exit forgives faster than we do. Find it.
Go with the wind. Better yet, go faster than it.
Travel in the cool hours. The road repays the patient.
May you find water where the map shows none.
Go gently, friend. The shade holds your seat.
Until the wind crosses our tracks again. Walk well.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_complim: Flattery. The dead were flattered too, probably.
Save the honey. We eat bread here.
The line doesn't run on compliments, but they weigh nothing. Accepted.
Sturdy? We're what's left. What's left gets called sturdy.
Ha, keep talking. Morale's cheaper than arrows and you're supplying it.
Careful, praise makes the recruits march taller. Then they get seen.
Compliments from flagged persons are reviewed for motive.
Noted. Flattery has no effect on assessment. Ever.
Feedback logged. Discipline's not pretty, it's just correct.
Acknowledged. The polish is procedure; the edge is practice.
Kind words, friend. I'll pass them up the chain — they're rare cargo.
Appreciated. Say it louder next time, my lieutenant needs the mood.
Honey from your jar. We will check it for wasps.
Pretty words. The desert has heard prettier from thirstier mouths.
Praise is a coin. We bite it first — no offense meant.
You admire the falcon. Good. Admire it from where the talons aren't.
May your tongue stay this sweet, friend. My cousins will want to hear it.
You honor us. In return: the west track floods at dusk. Avoid it.
dialogue.warfront.resp.greetings_rude_in: Mouth like that, this close to the wire. Some people dig their own quota.
Say it again. Slower. I want to remember it at your expense.
Rude. The line has heard worse from the sky. Still — watch it.
That mouth will cost you more than it earns. Free advice.
Ha! Only a friend insults us that badly and walks. You walk — once.
Bold words, friend. I'd duck if I were your hat.
Verbal aggression logged. You are now a pattern, not an incident.
That kind of talk moves you up a list you don't want to be on.
Disrespect noted for the record. The record is long and patient.
Say that to the duty officer. I'll wait. I'll enjoy waiting.
I'll pretend the wind took that one, friend. Wind's taking exactly one today.
Cute. Your file now says 'comedian'. It's not a promotion.
Spit at the desert and it returns to you on the wind. Always.
Words like broken glass. You will walk back over them barefoot.
An insult is a seed. Consider what you want growing on your road.
The tongue is a blade with no handle. You hold it badly.
Ha — a friend's insult. Still, feed it to the fire before it grows.
Between friends, one such arrow is a joke. The second is an arrow.
dialogue.warfront.opt.intel_base_where_h: Where do you all bunk down?
dialogue.warfront.opt.intel_base_point_m: Point me toward your base? I've got trade in mind.
dialogue.warfront.opt.intel_base_nearest: Where's the nearest camp of yours?
dialogue.warfront.opt.intel_base_visit_p: I'd like to visit your people. Which way do I go?
